nodes.label: Board Member Portrait 2 (glasses, hazy skyline, EXIF-rotated)
nodes.rationale: Photographic, ~4:3 landscape pixel canvas but the subject is stored rotated 90 degrees (sideways head). Clear-framed glasses, olive/grey t-shirt with small chest mark, neutral soft expression. Background is a city skyline seen through glass, heavily desaturated into pale cyan/teal haze. High-key, low-contrast, cool palette. Reads as a founder/technologist headshot, the counter-register to the formal suit in board_member_1.

nodes.label: EXIF Orientation Not Applied (asset defect)
nodes.rationale: board_member_2.jpg is stored with the subject lying on its side; the file carries a camera orientation flag that the raw pixels do not honour. Any renderer that ignores EXIF will show a rotated headshot. This needs a re-orientation pass (bake the rotation into pixels or re-encode from the source) before it can sit in a portrait grid next to its two upright siblings.
